$description: W3C DTCG-compliant motion and spring physics token catalog for egui-macview. Fully grounded in Apple CoreAnimation (QuartzCore), WebKit SpringSolver, AppKit NSAnimationContext, and SwiftUI Spring specifications.

differential_equation.$value: m * x''(t) + c * x'(t) + k * (x(t) - x_target) = 0
differential_equation.$description: Standard second-order linear ordinary differential equation for a damped harmonic oscillator.

settling_duration_formula.$value: t_settle = -ln(epsilon * sqrt(1 - zeta^2)) / (zeta * omega_0) ≈ 2 * m * ln(1 / epsilon) / c
settling_duration_formula.$description: Estimated time for oscillation amplitude to decay below rest tolerance epsilon (typically epsilon = 0.001 or 1/1000).

$extensions.apple_citation: Apple Developer Documentation - CASpringAnimation.settlingDuration; WebKit SpringSolver envelope decay

stiffness_from_response.$description: Converts undamped natural cycle period (response) to physical stiffness coefficient k.

damping_from_damping_ratio.$value: c = 4 * pi * dampingRatio * m / response = 2 * dampingRatio * sqrt(k * m)
damping_from_damping_ratio.$description: Converts dampingRatio (zeta) and response to physical damping coefficient c.

response_from_physics.$value: response = 2 * pi * sqrt(m / k) = 2 * pi / omega_0
response_from_physics.$description: Converts mass m and stiffness k to undamped cycle period (response).

damping_ratio_from_physics.$description: Converts damping c, mass m, and stiffness k to dimensionless damping ratio zeta.

damping_ratio_from_bounce.$description: Converts SwiftUI WWDC23 perceptual bounce to damping ratio zeta.

mass.$description: The mass of the object attached to the end of the spring.

damping.$description: The damping coefficient due to friction.

initial_velocity.$description: The initial velocity of the object attached to the spring at t=0.

natural_frequency.$description: Undamped angular frequency omega_0 = sqrt(k / m) in rad/s.

damping_ratio.$description: Damping ratio zeta = c / (2 * sqrt(k * m)). Underdamped (zeta < 1.0).

damped_frequency.$description: Damped angular frequency omega_d = omega_0 * sqrt(1 - zeta^2) in rad/s.

response.$description: Equivalent perceptual response period T = 2 * pi / omega_0 in seconds.

settling_duration.$description: Calculated settling duration at epsilon = 0.001 (1/1000) rest threshold.

caspring_default.$description: Default CoreAnimation CASpringAnimation physical parameters (underdamped harmonic oscillator).

response.$description: Nominal duration of one undamped cycle in seconds.

damping_ratio.$description: Damping fraction. Modern SwiftUI defaults to 1.0 (critically damped, no overshoot); legacy defaulted to 0.825.

blend_duration.$description: Duration over which to blend previous velocity into the spring transition.

settling_duration.$description: Settling duration for critically damped spring to reach 99.9% target state.

swiftui_spring_default.$description: Standard SwiftUI Animation.spring() default preset (iOS 17+ / macOS 14+).

response.$description: Ultra-low latency response period for gesture tracking in seconds.
